title: DecentraDial
tagline: A decentralized business directory for the modern web.
description: Business directories are centralized and dubious. DecentraDial is a decentralized business directory, where you find services or list your services. Maybe the new craigslist. No more hard times. Just dial in businesses with ERC721 token based provenance. Currently platforms like craigslist, just-dial and various other business classifieds are dubios and might have an internal agenda within the organization to mess with the ranking of the business listings within the platform. With the use of end to end decentralized implementation will ensure actual engagment within the app using the lens protocol for tracking the reviews of the customers within the business.
how_its_made: Ether.js library within the state management was little bit buggy, but we finally figured our browser was caching the wrong keys.
